postName: What to Write on a Flower Card — carousel

tokens.headline:
The flowers are
the easy part.
tokens.voice: the flowers are the easy part

tokens.lede:
The bouquet brings the colour.
The card explains why it’s there.
tokens.body: Staring at the blank message box — wondering whether to be funny, formal, brief or heartfelt? Take the pressure off. A card doesn’t need to sound like a poem. It just needs to sound like you paused, thought of them, and chose your words with care.
tokens.lead_in: A few to borrow, by moment —
tokens.voice: a few words to borrow, by moment —

tokens.quote_2: “A little birthday colour for your home — because you deserve to feel celebrated.”
tokens.quote_3: “Thank you for the way you made a hard week feel lighter.”
tokens.voice: for just because, for a birthday, for the thank-yous

tokens.quote_1: “I know flowers don’t fix this, but I hope they bring a little softness today.”
tokens.label_2: Just to say I love you
tokens.quote_2: “No reason — except that I love you and wanted something beautiful nearby.”
tokens.quote_3: “No words feel enough, but please know I’m here.”
tokens.voice: for just because, for a birthday, for the thank-yous

tokens.end_line: For the moment they feel what you meant.
tokens.voice: for the moment they feel what you meant
